## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is the *Aśokadattā-vyākaraṇa* — the Mahāyāna sūtra featuring the bodhisattva-girl *Āshùdá* 阿術達 (Aśokadattā), daughter of King Ajātaśatru of Magadha. Like [the Sumati sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0026) and other female-protagonist Mahāyāna sūtras, it is an important source for early Mahāyāna doctrinal-literary engagement with female religious subjectivity.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE).
